Container.Name: MKV-Auto
Container.Overview:
Automatic Blu-ray/DVD ripper with web interface.
Features: - Automatic disc detection and ripping - Web-based interface - MakeMKV integration - Metadata lookup via DiscDB - Post-processing and file organization - Transfer to network shares (SMB/NFS)
Requires optical drive(s) connected to your server.
Container.PostArgs:
# Disable CD-ROM autoclose on host to prevent auto-reinsertion echo 0 > /proc/sys/dev/cdrom/autoclose 2>/dev/null || true
# Make permanent for Unraid if [ ! -f /boot/config/modprobe.d/cdrom.conf ]; then mkdir -p /boot/config/modprobe.d echo "options sr_mod autoclose=0" > /boot/config/modprobe.d/cdrom.conf fi

Config.Name: Optical Drive
Config.Description: First optical drive (add more as needed)

Config.Name: MakeMKV Registration Key
Config.Description: Optional. Applies your MakeMKV key on every start and writes it to MakeMKV's own settings.conf. Leave blank to set it in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. TMDB v3 API key for title auto-suggestions. Leave blank to set it in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Media Server
Config.Description: Optional. Output naming format: plex or jellyfin.

Config.Name: Discord Enabled
Config.Description: Optional. Turn Discord notifications on: true or false.

Config.Name: Auto-rip on Insert
Config.Description: Optional. Start copying automatically once a disc finishes scanning: true or false.

Config.Name: Eject on Finish
Config.Description: Optional. Eject the disc when a job finishes: true or false.

Config.Name: Eject on Restart
Config.Description: Optional. Eject the disc when the container restarts: true or false.

Config.Name: Movie Path Template
Config.Description: Optional. Output path template for movies.

Config.Name: Series Path Template
Config.Description: Optional. Output path template for series.

Config.Name: Preview Duration (seconds)
Config.Description: Optional. Length of each preview clip in seconds.

Config.Name: Max Parallel Previews
Config.Description: Optional. How many previews to generate at once.
